initiatives.name: Union for Radical Political Economics (URPE)
initiatives.description: Membership organization of academics and activists, founded in 1968, that studies radical political economy. Publishes the Review of Radical Political Economics and runs conference panels, caucuses and webinars.

initiatives.name: Counter Currents
initiatives.description: Reader-funded independent news site based in Kottayam district, Kerala, India. Publishes left-leaning articles on politics, movements and the environment, mostly about India.

initiatives.name: Green and Red Podcast
initiatives.description: Podcast hosted by Bob Buzzanco and Scott Parkin. Interviews organizers, academics and artists on radical environmental, labor and anti-capitalist politics.

initiatives.name: CounterVortex
initiatives.description: Independent news and commentary site run by Bill Weinberg in New York City. Publishes daily reports, features and podcasts on global politics, conflict and social movements.
